claims.claim: The item is a Harman/Kardon portable keyboard (pink case).
claims.evidence: Witness report shows brand text visible on the front (Photo 1) and the keyboard/case is shown open (Photo 0) and closed (Photos 1–2).

claims.claim: The seller is offering it for sale and you can DM for budget fit.
claims.evidence: This is only the seller’s message; the witness report does not confirm pricing or availability.

risks.risk: Unknown exact model/specs (only brand text readable), which affects value and compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear photo/screenshot of the full model number/spec label (usually on the back/bottom) and the full front panel text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic/unknown portable keyboard with uncertain specs.

risks.risk: Functionality not confirmed (keys may be dead, stuck, or unresponsive).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing power-on and a few keys being pressed with visible response (and any on-screen indicators if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested/unknown working condition.

risks.risk: Power type and voltage unknown (battery vs adapter; correct charger not included).
risks.proof: Photo of the power input label/port and the included adapter (if any), plus a close-up of voltage rating.
risks.if_unproven: Price as requiring the buyer to supply the correct power/adapter.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (adapter, stand, sustain pedal, manual) not shown.
risks.proof: A photo of everything included laid out (adapter/pedal/manual/any cables).

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible (cracks, hinge/latch failure, worn keys, missing keys).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of hinges/latches, corners/edges, and a full view of the keybed showing all keys.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average used condition with possible wear.

risks.risk: Connectivity/features unknown (USB/MIDI/headphone outputs) and whether ports work.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of all ports/connectors and a quick test video for at least one port (e.g., headphone output).
risks.if_unproven: Price without assuming extra working connectivity.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the full model number/spec label (back/bottom) so we can confirm the exact keyboard.
Send a short video showing the keyboard powering on and multiple keys being pressed (confirm sound/response).
Send photos of the power input/charging port and confirm whether an adapter is included; include voltage rating if present.
Send a photo of all accessories included (adapter, sustain pedal, stand, manual, cables).
Send close-ups of the latch/hinge and corners, plus a full view showing whether any keys are missing or damaged.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a Harman/Kardon portable keyboard in a pink hard case, so it can be priced at a worst-case used/untested level. Missing model/specs, power details, and working condition require conservative pricing until proof is provided.
